channel.title: The Wild Hunt
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Wild Hunt" - The Wild Hunt is said to appear during the most destructive of storms, caring away those unfortunate enough to be outside

item.title: Re: The Wild Hunt
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there Atomholic. Let's take a look at your concept.

While I applaud your enthusiasm for mythology and desire to bring them to life, there are much better ways to do it besides simply retelling the entire myth word for word. That's what your Central Narrative reads like at the moment: a list of multiple anomalies that happen one after another without additional context or explanation as to their significance.

This does not make for an interesting narrative. Consider SCP-1826, which also involves elements of the mythic Wild Hunt. Notice how they do not simply list the Hunt as a singular event, but weave it into a modern setting, where the Foundation and other characters are also intrinsically involved. You might need to do that here as well. Don't just re-tell a myth as an scp. Instead, find a unique angle / perspective from which to convey elements of the myth.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I'll take another look. Best of luck for now!

item.title: Re: The Wild Hunt
item.content:encoded: I'm glad you like it. The Mythology has been an interest for a few years now and figured it could make for an interesting SCP at the least. though my plans with the Wild Hunt here is very loosely based of its Mythology origins.

item.title: The Wild Hunt
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mythology

Page Layout: towards the bottom of the full article, I plan on having a series of procedures for luring people indoors away from the storm with some discontinued due to not having the desired effect or being too impractical

Elevator Pitch: based around the core mythology of the Wild Hunt a group of knights lead by a king that appear during extremely powerful storms.

Central Narrative:

+ Show
- Hide

Appearing only in polar and arctic regions during powerful storms.

At the height of the storm, suddenly it'll breaks as if in the storms eye. The sky appears as night, lit by an aroura with Knights, Yeomen, Footmen and hounds seen running in the light in the direction of the storm.

A king appears on horseback and waves anyone outside to join The Hunt. Any male 12 years or older, fall under a kind of mind control, 'willingly' joining the Wild Hunt.

3 separate operations are launched to make contact with the Wild Hunt. The first operation results in the team “joining The Wild Hunt”.

The second, involving a D-class equipped with eyewear who insults The King after being called a peasant and asked to join The Hunt.

several Large white furred hounds with red tipped ears, and two knights on skeletal horses, with both the horse armour and knights being equally rusted. From both the knights and horses eye sockets emanates a blue mist. appear in nearby forest and charge him.

the D-class was later found as little more than strands of flesh.

The third attempt was successful with a scientist undertaking the operation without consent. The scientist bowed as the aroura appeared, showing respect to The King.

According to The King, a great hunter and leader of men in his life, serves the “One True God” with his purpose being to “Protect the Realm of Man”, though no evidence is found to support this.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The Mythology of the Wild Hunt their purpose and the containment procedures. since a storm cannot be contained the foundation use entertainment media (flash online sales of media/ games, putting popular shows on tv, using media to exaggerate severity of storm). those outside during the storms are written off as casualties of the storm.

Additional Notes: what is the term for a mind controlling or luring component of an SCP? I’m fairly sure I have heard of it before.
